q: Which feedback signal makes the best labeled example?
options: A user’s edit or correction of the output
explain: The corrected version is a target.

q: What stops a data flywheel from turning?
options: Data that is logged but never curated, labeled or used

q: Why be careful training on your own model’s outputs?
options: It can reinforce the model’s own mistakes
explain: Prefer human-corrected data and evaluate on held-out real traffic.
